Two locally valid evidence chains could therefore be co-sealed without proving they were one causal path.
review_negative_evidence.resolution: The same generation was hardened before merge: positive contract-scope sealing now requires exactly one UPTAKEN recipient under the v1 probe ABI and exact equality between its WP507/WP508 downstream digest and the intervention arm downstream-output digest. A regression test rejects detached positive downstream evidence.
